overview: The Medford City Council appointed Laurel Siegel as the new City Clerk and approved significant infrastructure measures including easements for the Main Street Corridor safety project and several capital stabilization appropriations. Members also engaged in a lengthy debate regarding fiscal year-end transfers, focusing on public safety overtime costs and DPW budget surpluses.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the special joint meeting records from June 24 and a committee report on arts funding, while the records for June 23 were tabled.

items.title: Election of City Clerk
items.summary: Approved the election of Laurel Siegel as City Clerk for a three-year term effective August 10, 2026.

items.title: MBTA Bus Redesign Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution to inform residents about MBTA bus redesign meetings, amended to request that the administration use all communication methods to reach the community.

items.title: Auto-Pay Option Investigation
items.summary: Tabled a resolution to investigate auto-pay options for city bills to allow for further research into current system capabilities.

items.title: Disability Commission Ordinance Update
items.summary: Passed a first reading of an updated ordinance for the Commission for Persons with Disabilities to modernize terminology and clarify the commission's role.

items.title: Capital and General Stabilization Appropriations
items.summary: Approved various school-related capital projects and an IT server replacement, while tabling a request for a police chief recruitment search.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Ordained amendments to the personnel ordinance for the Assistant Network Administrator and Tree Warden positions.

items.title: Hormel Stadium Commission Appointment
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Ryan O’Keefe to the Hormel Stadium Commission.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 Year-End Transfers
items.summary: Approved budget transfers to cover departmental deficits, leading to a discussion regarding high overtime expenditures in the Fire Department and surpluses in the DPW budget.

items.title: Litigation Settlements
items.summary: Approved three litigation settlements totaling $10,649.26 for property and vehicle damage caused by city snowplows.

items.title: Main Street Corridor Easements and Layout Alteration
items.summary: Approved the order of alteration of layout and the order of taking for easements necessary for the MassDOT Main Street and Mystic Avenue intersection project.

items.title: Oak Grove Building Study Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a $24,550 appropriation for a conceptual building study and construction cost estimate for the Oak Grove Cemetery operations building.
